notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Released
notes.content:
It's been a while, but I finally managed to get some time to address some of the issues people have been having.

This is also using the latest version of VRTK (github commit hash 18bbce2347c4ec08fcdb056e65f62676857032c0) so hopefully it has fixed some older bugs as well!

Changes are:

 * Update to new version of VRTK
 * Improve physics on Alley Ball
 * Change darts to a standard dart board
 * Tweak darts physics (still could do with work)
 * Rotate all play areas so the standard forward facing direction is the direction of the games.
 * Moved play area closer to games to give more room to play.
 * Added better info message on splash screen and entrance screen


I hope to get some time soon to add some more mini games!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
The latest version is mainly bug fixes and updating to the latest version of VRTK to see if any bugs have arisen (which there were a couple so thanks to Funfair they were squashed!).

A couple of other minor changes:

 * Menu on Ferris Wheel no longer collides with seat
 * Can no longer cheat in darts by walking up to the board
 * Darts make a sound when thrown and when hit the board
 * Objects like basketball, alley balls and darts highlight when touched

Keep playing and testing!
